text: The project uniquely combines flood and drought mitigation through infrastructure rehabilitation and community engagement. It features a blend of climate finance, including loans and grants, and emphasizes gender mainstreaming and community ownership. The initiative also leverages regional knowledge for local implementation, with a strong focus on community-based disaster risk management and water governance.

metadata.solution_name: Greater Mekong Subregion Flood and Drought Risk Management and Mitigation Project (Cambodia component)
